name: 3D Gaussian Splatting as Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC)
aliases: 3D Gaussian Splatting as Markov Chain Monte Carlo
definition: Interprets the training process of placing and optimizing Gaussians as a sampling process from a distribution G, rather than minimizing a loss function via gradient descent. This allows discrete operations (splitting, pruning) without breaking MCMC continuity assumptions.
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting as Markov Chain Monte Carlo reinterprets training as sampling, enabling discrete structural changes via MCMC moves to avoid gradient-based discontinuities.
